hinweis: Zahlen nur hier. In Texten als {limit:schluessel} einsetzen. Vor dem Livegang jeden Wert erneut gegen die Learn-Seite lesen und geprueft_am setzen.

laufzeit_max.learn_zitat: Run duration: 30 days. After 30 days, any pending steps time out.

schleife_parallel_max.learn_zitat: Apply to each concurrency: 1 is the default limit. You can change the default to a value between 1 and 50 inclusively.

trigger_warteschlange.learn_zitat: Waiting runs: 10 plus the degree of parallelism (1-100) when Concurrency Control is on. Bei Parallelitaet 1 also 11.

trigger_parallel.learn_zitat: Concurrent runs: 1 to 100 when Concurrency Control is turned on (defaults to 25). Turning on Concurrency Control can't be undone without deleting and re-adding the trigger.
